items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR
Award Contract No. PW-008R Moscone West Solar to Albion Power Company, Inc. to construct a rooftop solar electric system
items.text: Award Contract No. PW-008R Moscone West Solar to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Albion Power Company, Inc., in the amount of $4,293,002 and with a duration of 240 consecutive calendar days (approximately eight months) to construct a rooftop solar electric system (837 kW/DC) located at 800 Howard Street, San Francisco, 94103. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The San Francisco Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on the determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Award Contract No. HH-1022, Cherry Valley Dam Spillway Short-Term Improvement and Eleanor Dam Bridge Interim Repair, to Njirich & Sons, Inc
items.text: Award Contract No. HH-1022, Cherry Valley Dam Spillway Short-Term Improvement and Eleanor Dam Bridge Interim Repair, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Njirich & Sons, Inc., in the amount of $8,674,300, and with a contract duration of 455 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and three months), to re-establish the flow path of the Cherry Valley Dam spillway which was damaged in a spill event in 2010, and to repair the concrete and replace the bridge deck overlay of the Eleanor Dam Bridge. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Eleanor Dam Bridge Interim Repair Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h). The San Francisco Planning Department has determined that the Eleanor Dam Bridge Interim Repair Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on the determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Award Contract No. WD-2886, University Mound Reservoir North Basin Roof Coating, to Angelus Waterproofing and Restoration, Inc., to recoat the entirety of the University Mound Reservoir
items.text: Award Contract No. WD-2886, University Mound Reservoir North Basin Roof Coating, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Angelus Waterproofing and Restoration, Inc., in the amount of $2,838,777 and with a duration of 154 consecutive calendar days (approximately five months), to recoat the entirety of the University Mound Reservoir north basin roof slab

items.title: Authorize the General Manager to establish the operational rules for San Bruno’s new Acapella Well No. 21 as a Shared Facility
items.text: Authorize the General Manager to execute a Memorandum of Agreement with the City of San Bruno to establish the operational rules for San Bruno’s new Acapella Well No. 21 as a Shared Facility as defined under the terms of the Operating Agreement for the Regional Groundwater Storage and Recovery Project, dated August 12, 2014

items.title: Award Contract No. PRO.0327, HHWP NERC Compliance and Audit Support to Archer Energy Solutions, LLC, to assist with Hetch Hetchy Water and Power
items.text: Award Contract No. PRO.0327, HHWP NERC Compliance and Audit Support to Archer Energy Solutions, LLC, in the amount not-to-exceed $11,600,000 and with a duration of five years, to provide as-needed professional services to assist with Hetch Hetchy Water and Power in meeting the obligations to the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), Western Electricity Coordinating Council, California Independent System Operator, and California Public Utilities Commission regulatory compliance programs, subject to Board of Supervisors approval under Charter Section 9.118
